feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 18 May 2026 4:15pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 18 May 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure west of Ireland, moving eastwards, associated fronts affecting the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

South 4 or 5, but variable 2 or 3 in the east of the area at first, becoming southeast 4 or 5 in all waters later this evening, then increasing 5 or 6 overnight. Veering south tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building moderate overnight.


##Weather##

Rain spreading from the southwest this evening, clearing to scattered showers tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 5 or 6, veering west or southwest 4 or 5 overnight into Wednesday, backing southwest Wednesday morning.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, occasionally rough in the south at first.


##Weather##

Scattered showers, soon becoming isolated.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in showers.
